questions.prompt: How should you approach a large reading list?

options.text: Treat every page as equally important.
Prioritize with attention to the course’s needs.

questions.explanation: The episode suggests assessing the class and distinguishing core from supplemental reading.

questions.prompt: Why be skeptical of extreme speed-reading promises?

options.text: Comprehension and visual processing impose limits.
Reading never gets faster with practice.

questions.explanation: Recognizing text and understanding it both take processing time.

questions.prompt: What helps decide whether to read closely or skim?

options.text: The color of the book cover.
How many pages your friends skip.
How the reading fits the class and its main concepts.

questions.explanation: Different courses make different demands; evaluate what the assignment contributes.
